full_name: Leah Whittington | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Humanities Radcliffe Alumnae Fellow Harvard University
bio: Leah Whittington is the John L. Loeb Associate Professor of the Humanities in the Department of English and an affiliate of the Department of the Classics at Harvard University. She specializes in the literature and culture of the European Renaissance, with a focus on the rediscovery, appropriation, and transformation of classical antiquity.
